episode_law.attention: A causal partial-minute volume multiple at or above 5x opens an observation episode but never enters the treatment cohort by itself.
episode_law.eligibility: An episode enters the frozen cohort only after its latched level reaches at least 10x.
episode_law.tradeable_and_regime_labels: 12x and 20x remain categorical morphology labels only; they have no prospective order, timing, sizing, or capital authority.
episode_law.terminal: The seconds owner NORMALIZED transition or the exact Stage-112 completed-minute release, roll, gap, maintenance, or Friday-flat boundary closes an episode.
episode_law.reset_precedence: An external Stage-112 reset closes the old episode before an observation at the same timestamp, permitting a genuinely new second-wave episode without inheriting state.
episode_law.clock: IBKR TCP packet receipt UTC for seconds evidence; finalized broker close UTC for completed-minute and slower context. No exchange timestamp is inferred.

context_law.scoring_owner: Only the frozen seconds crest owner determines levels, direction, crest, continuation, rotation, reversal eligibility, and normalization.
non_scoring_annotations: CL and MCL 5s, 15s, and 60s velocity plus 15m slope velocity and acceleration
rolling completed-minute 240m slope velocity and acceleration
strictly prior five-session MCL return and median minute true range
causal MCL news pressure, delta, velocity, and treatment age
context_law.volume_clock_audit: Receipt-bucket trade volume is compared with finalized broker-minute volume as an audit; minute identity is not asserted across the two timestamp domains.

settlement_law.before_gate: Record only immutable morphology and categorical counts. Do not expose returns, MFE, MAE, PnL, matched-control labels, or a winner.
settlement_law.after_gate: Freeze matched controls and economic settlement in a successor preregistration before exposing any treatment outcome.
settlement_law.thresholds: Do not refit 5x, 10x, 12x, 20x, crest persistence, continuation, reversal, or reset thresholds from the prospective cohort.
